posts.text: Replying to @Ed Well, if it isn’t the consequences of your own actions, John F Mann (and hello to you too Nate Mann)! Oh did you think that because the cops didn’t arrest you that day that you escaped accountability?! No, John, the Find Out stage of FAFO has just begun! When I was 9, I looked up to that counselor bc I had never had that much positive attention- someone telling me how funny and smart and great I was - esp from a male figure. And for YEARS I thought so highly of him, until I looked at it through the lens and playing back all the times he brought up my speedo to “tease” me, and all the funny jokes were really just cr33py comments bc he was gr00ming me. So no, I don’t care about legalities, you do not film children without consent bc YOU are the ad

Imagine thinking that saying that your 62yo father was cr33pily filming a 16yo CHILD bc he wanted his 31yo son to ask her out is going to make you look good. 🥴🤢 But I guess that’s on par for the son of a man who said “filming in public isn’t illegal” when confronted with filming a CHILD and trying to follow her to school (allegedly) #johnmann #natemann #carlsbad #consequences #thisyou

Bc it takes a village and we have to look after each other. #cesarchavez #doloreshuerta #protectchidren #protectwomen #believevictims
